Elton John performed the first show tonight at the new Apple Music Hall in London, with Apple Music subscribers able to watch it live instantly.

Elton John performs the first show at Apple Music Hall

Apple announced the Apple Music Hall located at Battersea Power Station in London just a few days ago, and Elton John was the first to take the stage, opening with "Your Song."

Tickets officially went on sale today, with tickets for upcoming shows featuring Baby Keem and Skye Newman also available for purchase.

The 600-capacity Apple Music Hall is situated inside Battersea Power Station and is designed for intimate live performances that can be simultaneously recorded and streamed to a global audience.

The venue features a 38-foot stage, a Spatial Audio system with 48 speakers, a dedicated recording and mixing studio, and infrastructure for multi-camera video production.

If you're an Apple Music subscriber, you can watch Elton John's performance at the Apple Music Hall here.

Here is the schedule for upcoming Apple Music Hall shows:

  • Baby Keem — October 2
  • Skye Newman — October 7
  • Troye Sivan — October 13
  • Arlo Parks — October 22
  • Burna Boy — October 29
  • Chase & Status — November 26
  • Charli xcx — December 2

For more information on tickets and availability, please follow this link.

Apple Music requires a valid subscription. You can subscribe for $11.99 per month, with the first month free, or through an Apple One bundle.

Would you like to attend a concert at the Apple Music Hall in person? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
